lines.text:
Are you heading up the Pokémon Tower?
What a kind child you are!\c
...I have an idea!\c
I bet the Pokémon here would be even happier
to see you if you had a spiffy outfit on.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Formal Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] from the old lady!
You put the [VAR COLOR(0006)]Formal Set[VAR COLOR(0000)] in your Clothing Trunk!

Hello, dear.
How did you like the outfit?\c
I wanted you to wear it because you looked like
my grand[VAR GENDBR(00FF,0803)]sondaughter.
